_comment: Every model byte this image carries, pinned by sha256. Added by Super Protocol, 2026.
Upstream fetches nothing: its models live inside two NVIDIA NIM containers, which
need an NGC credential and five GPUs between them. These are fetched once at BUILD
time and baked in, so a deployment reaches no model host at all and the image digest
the listing pins covers the weights as well as the code. `fetch_models.py` refuses a
file whose sha256 does not match, which is what makes the pin a pin.
Licences are recorded here because they travel with the bytes: see /licenses in the
built image and the listing's own `licences` output.

conditions: No restriction on use, commercial or otherwise, and no user-count ceiling.
The licence and the copyright notice travel with any redistribution.
No restriction on use, commercial or otherwise.
The MIT notice travels with any redistribution; it is at /licenses/models/.
licence.note: Converted from pyannote/segmentation-3.0, which is MIT and gated behind an acceptance click on Hugging Face. This conversion is not gated, and MIT permits the redistribution either way, so a deployment needs no Hugging Face account.

conditions: ATTRIBUTION IS REQUIRED: the model is credited to NVIDIA on the listing page, in /licenses/models/ and in this manifest.
Changes made must be indicated: the file is an ONNX export of the published checkpoint, unmodified in weights.
